procedure.method: Fresh independent critic session; no spawn, fork, resume, peer/producer/planner record inspection or image production/editing. Read the exact packet, literal case, rubric, rules, compact method/addendum and pinned adapter. Verified pins and read all five pinned native-evidence manifests before poster viewing; did not follow their embedded unlisted source/call paths. Packet source_assets and protected_layouts are both empty, so there were zero source-image opens and zero protected-layout reads to perform. Used functions.exec with tools.view_image(detail=original), forwarding each returned image_url to image(..., original), sequentially: M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2, M3, M4 and M5 in the same view order. All 15 exact images were actually displayed and visually inspected before starting intentional copy-reading/transcription, judgment or scoring. The native opens were 1672x941, use opens 720x405 and thumbnail opens 320x180. Hash/header verification was only binding evidence and was not treated as viewing. First readings were taken from the displayed native pixels, with the already displayed usage and thumbnail views used for readability/layout evaluation. No actual ambiguity required a revisit, and there were no additional poster opens. No tool event or runtime session identity is fabricated; session_id is null.

evidence.observation: The wall opening and light/shadow spread remain substantial and legible at use size, making the subject of the architectural exhibition visible. They are not tiny ornaments or a texture-only backdrop.

content_form.location: whole interior and lower-left event descriptor
content_form.observation: The photographic room makes architecture itself the viewing subject; the sunlight resting across wall and floor gives a concrete counterpart to the title. The single paired descriptor binds the photograph exhibition and space story into one event.
The newcomer-facing phrases remain clearly readable, tempering the formal empty-room photograph with an invitation to participate.

hierarchy.location: lower-left title group to upper-right schedule and middle-right offer group

typography.location: date/time, middle-right dot-separated rows and lower-right phrases

space.location: blue near wall, central opening and sunlit floor
space.observation: The near wall gives the low title group a stable plane; the empty upper wall counterbalances the open room. The title, date group, offer group and floor notes follow four distinct surface locations without collisions.

image_material.location: central window reveal and adjoining floor
image_material.observation: Plaster relief, wood window trim, leaf shadows and floor reflections have consistent local detail. The floor and doorway convey readable depth while leaving usable light surfaces for information.

emotion_control.observation: Warm natural light and a calm unoccupied interior invite slow observation; the reassurance copy softens the formal architectural setting into an approachable adult event.

ai_slop.observation: The major construction reads consistently, shadows are tied to a visible window/foliage context, and no random icons, pseudo-lettering or decorative fragments interrupt the message.

residuals: The empty room communicates the photographic subject more directly than communal explanation; the space-talk component depends on the descriptor rather than visible participants.
The practical copy is readable at usage720 but not suited to detailed reading at thumbnail320.
The still sunlit photographic interior overlaps the general visual family of M2, despite a different spatial and information organization.

evidence.location: rust openings, right skylight and reflective floor
evidence.observation: The large photographic architectural views include physical openings, reflected sunlight, floor depth and a skylight. These nonglyph subjects provide substantive architectural/light observation.

evidence.observation: The two architectural views dominate the frame and remain recognizable at use size; their scale and spatial construction are much more substantial than lettering, texture or tiny ornament.

content_form.location: left portals and right skylit wall
content_form.observation: Contrasting enclosed passages and overhead daylight supply concrete examples of architectural form and light. The event descriptor and title make those photographs the subject of one exhibition/space-story event, rather than a branded building promotion.

hierarchy.location: central title versus lower-right event descriptor and corner information
hierarchy.observation: The title is stacked on a narrow central pier, but the descriptor identifying the exhibition and talk sits far away at the lower right. Schedule is upper left, offers upper right and reassurance lower left; finding the event type and then its participation information requires scanning five separate islands.
The tall portal and bright diagonal image compete with the short stacked title. The separated descriptor is visually small, so the event identity does not consolidate into a strong first reading.

typography.location: central title, top-left rows and lower-left white text
typography.observation: Korean glyphs and Roman capitals are clean, the three-line title breaks only at word boundaries, and the dark/light text choices suit their immediate surfaces.

typography.location: schedule, venue, offers and visitor instructions
typography.observation: Every practical row can be read, with colons, date periods, en dash, middle dots and word spaces retained.

space.location: central cream pier and detached lower-right descriptor
space.observation: The title consumes the upper-middle part of the tall pier while a long unoccupied lower section continues to the floor. Meanwhile its event descriptor occupies a remote right-hand plane. Architectural planes offer clear text surfaces, but their use does not bring the related name/type information together.

space.location: five text islands surrounding the joined architectural images
space.observation: The wide gaps between the central name and corner groups make the composition feel distributed rather than resolved as an invitation and a practical-information sequence.

image_material.location: left rust opening, right skylight, plaster and floor reflections
image_material.observation: Local materials and lighting are convincing, with visible plaster texture, deep recesses and smooth floor reflections. The hard center join separates differently oriented architectural views; it is readable as image assembly rather than a claim of one continuous room.

emotion_control.location: warm rust planes, blue sky and lower-left reassurance
emotion_control.observation: The warm/cool architectural contrast and tree shadows communicate enjoyment of observing light. The legible reassuring phrases keep the dramatic empty spaces compatible with an adult neighborhood invitation, although the experience is more formal than M3 or M5.

ai_slop.location: portal edges, skylight, floor and text surfaces
ai_slop.observation: The large image fragments remain legible architectural subjects; no pseudo-copy, ornamental icons or branding is visible. The main unresolved feature is the editorial distribution of real information rather than arbitrary nonglyph clutter.

residuals: Hierarchy 3: name and exhibition/talk descriptor remain remote, and the practical reading path crosses five widely separated text islands.
Space 3: the long lower portion of the title pier does not resolve the separation between name and event descriptor.
The central image join divides different spatial viewpoints; it should not be read as evidence of a single physically continuous room.
The photographic light-filled interiors retain a family resemblance to M1.
